title: Product Manager - Technology
job_description:
4-8

Noida

Full-Time

  

**Qualifications:**

BE/BTech/MCA or any relevant degree with a background in consumer internet products

4-6 years’ experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them -you’re extremely proud of what you’ve accomplished.

You carry the optimum blend of business, creativity (UI/UX) and technology.

You are hands-on and go-getter to build & enhance your product through teamwork.

You are on a constant drive to expand the product through research & stitching new partnerships.

You’re expected to be a polymath who can bring ideas and analogies from different domains to solve a problem. You should be able to understand third or fourth level metrics.

Stellar design instincts and product taste

Finger-tippiness with data: you just go get the data you need with no muss/fuss and can whip it into an insightful story with no help. You know how to leverage data to make decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysis.

Grittiness: You never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on, you persevere when others fall away.

Own product charter & build Product Roadmap

Develop Wireframe & PRD for new features / services.

Understand Digital Technologies involved in responsive web development & API Integrations.

Hands-on experience on various product development and product management tools including but limited to Jira / Confluence / Miro / Google Analytics / Martech / CRM.

Candidates from a travel & accommodation (Market place, Property Management System and Channel Manager) background will be preferred.

Should have experience in managing B2C/B2B products - responsive web & mobile app(Android/iOS) user Interfaces.

Most importantly, you should be fun to work with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Manage Responsive Web,Mobile App, CRM, Property Management System, and all other major building blocks.

Driving Lead & Conversion Growth - Visitor to Lead & Lead to Successful Closure through UX, Research, Data driven Features and meticulous execution.

Break silos, drive wow experiences and create efficiencies through digital adoptions.

You’ll be responsible for absorbing all the complexities of the domain and making simple, elegant and polished products for our users. You’ll have to learn and unlearn fast across domains.

You’ll be working closely with the engineers, designers and analysts and marketing team who care deeply about their product. You should be able to quickly build rapport with them. Persuasiveness is more valued here than authority.

You’ll be owning product charters and would be responsible for every delivery. Your product charter will change as we evolve.

You should be able to understand macro changes in the market and identify potential opportunities and risks. You should be able to plan features in smaller sprints while keeping an eye on the larger vision.

You’ll be extremely meticulous and prudent in testing every feature that goes out. We ship high quality software.

You’ll be the internal evangelist of the product who will go to everyone and help them understand why we should build a feature.

**Soft Skills:**

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

Team player who can adapt to new and evolving processes.

title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**Role description**

**Principal Product Manager, Commerce**

**Who We Are**

At Cimpress, we are building the technology platform that powers mass customization at scale. Our Commerce domain gives Cimpress businesses the flexibility to create modern, data-driven commerce experiences, launch new products, enter new markets and scale their operations efficiently.

Our Commerce platform includes CimCommerce v2 (CCv2), CimCommerce v1 (CCv1) and Platform Orders. Together, these products provide the foundation for web-to-print mass customization while enabling future growth through marketplaces, AI innovation and omnichannel experiences.

As Cimpress scales towards $10B in annual transaction volume, we continue to evolve our commerce capabilities to support increasingly complex business needs.

**What You Will Do**

As a Principal Product Manager in Commerce, you will define the product vision and strategy for enterprise-level commerce and order management capabilities. You will help build a unified application that brings together order management, customer management, order remediation and contact centre capabilities into a seamless experience.

The product will serve as a single point of interaction for customer care and sales agents across Cimpress businesses, integrating telephony, chat, cases, AI-driven agent assistance and core commerce and order management APIs.

You will work with two primary customer groups:

* External customers: Cimpress businesses that need efficient and scalable ways to manage customer orders.
* Internal customers: Cimpress Technology teams that build, integrate and continuously evolve the platform.

You will be responsible for setting the vision, defining the roadmap and establishing the foundation for the Commerce domain's AI strategy. You will also lead and mentor Product Managers within your product line.

### **Customer Focus**

* Build strong, collaborative relationships with global merchants, customer care specialists and technology teams to understand their workflows and challenges.
* Identify underlying customer needs beyond stated requirements and translate them into solutions that simplify agent workflows and improve customer satisfaction.
* Anticipate business growth and evolving merchant requirements to build scalable order management capabilities.
* Understand the business context and the underlying reasons behind customer requests.

### **Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and communicate a clear product vision and roadmap for enterprise commerce and order management capabilities.
* Track industry trends, emerging technologies and innovations to continuously improve product experiences.
* Establish the foundation for the Commerce domain's AI strategy, including AI-driven agent assistance.
* Navigate complex and ambiguous problem spaces by bringing together inputs from Cimpress businesses, engineering, operations and leadership.
* Drive the evolution of capabilities across order creation, processing, management and remediation.

### **Execution & Results**

* Drive the integration of complex products and capabilities across multiple teams and Cimpress Technology domains.
* Use data and insights to inform product decisions, considering order volumes, merchant satisfaction and system performance.
* Define clear success metrics and regularly measure product outcomes.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities and technical considerations to deliver meaningful results.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Develop a strong understanding of how enterprise applications integrate with APIs, events, microservices and the broader technology platform.
* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to define scalable solutions and make informed technical trade-offs.
* Drive the development of robust system architecture and next-generation AI-powered agent assistance.
* Ensure product capabilities deliver reliable, scalable and high-quality user experiences.

### **Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work across multiple product teams to deliver seamless experiences for customers of Cimpress businesses.
* Lead, mentor and develop 1–2 direct-report Product Managers while supporting the growth of junior PMs across the domain.
* Build alignment and influence decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
* Collaborate effectively with engineering, business stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Actively seek feedback and adapt product direction based on data, customer insights and stakeholder inputs.
* Foster inclusive, respectful and collaborative working practices.

**Your Qualifications**

We are looking for someone who brings strong product leadership, technical understanding and the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments. You should be comfortable balancing strategic thinking with execution and influencing stakeholders across different functions and levels.

### **Product Management Experience**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling B2B SaaS platforms or internal, multi-tenant enterprise applications.
* Experience managing complex products involving multiple stakeholders, teams and technology domains.
* Deep understanding of e-commerce, order management or similar mission-critical enterprise systems.
* Experience working with internal engineering teams as customers, particularly in platform products, infrastructure or internal tools.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge requests and say no when required while maintaining alignment with the broader product strategy.

### **Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Working knowledge of APIs, event-driven architectures and microservices.
* Ability to engage in meaningful technical discussions with engineers around system design, architecture and trade-offs.
* Understanding of system reliability and performance considerations, including uptime, latency and throughput.
* Understanding of the data requirements and considerations for AI/ML applications.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into business outcomes and product decisions.
* Experience in CRM, Contact Centre or Commerce domains.
* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and platforms such as AWS Connect.

### **Leadership & Strategic Skills**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build consensus across multiple teams.
* Strong business judgment, strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly through written communication, presentations and discussions.
* Experience building, mentoring and developing product teams.
* A genuine interest in understanding the needs of engineers, merchants and end users.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with AI-powered agent assistance tools and enterprise AI applications.
* Experience integrating contact centre technologies such as Salesforce Omni-Channel or Amazon Connect.
* Understanding of complex contact routing logic, including uHVC.
* Experience building enterprise applications that integrate customer management, order management, ticketing and communication capabilities.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Meaningful product challenges: Work on complex, large-scale commerce and order management platforms that support multiple Cimpress businesses.
* Ownership and impact: Shape product vision and strategy while influencing technology and business decisions across the organisation.
* Innovation: Explore emerging technologies, AI capabilities and new ways of solving enterprise commerce challenges.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with talented product, engineering, architecture and business teams across the organisation.
* Leadership opportunities: Mentor Product Managers and help shape the future direction of the Commerce domain.

**We're Remote-First**

Cimpress embraces a remote-first working environment, providing flexibility and opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across geographies.

We value ownership, collaboration, accountability and the ability to deliver meaningful outcomes regardless of where you work.

**About Us**

Cimpress is a global leader in mass customization. Through our network of businesses and technology platforms, we empower customers to make personalized products and bring their ideas to life.

Cimpress Technology builds the platforms, infrastructure and capabilities that enable our businesses to innovate, scale and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Cimpress is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to contribute, grow and succeed.

We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and experiences and believe that different perspectives make us stronger.

 **Skills**

Technical Product Management

 **About Cimpress**  
Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end-to-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Management Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will: • Identify, analyze and interpret business data using various kinds of techniques to meet business needs and requirements. • Activate the connective tissue between U.S. Bank, customer experience, digital, technology, and business line strategy to identify and prioritize product / portfolio opportunities, and establish the product vision, charter and roadmap. • Defines product outcomes and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prioritize Features/Epics and breaks down work into actionable steps to facilitate product discovery, design, development and delivery. • Manages the end-to-end product lifecycle and drives the product roadmap leveraging OKRs (Objectives and Key Results). Creates the product in conjunction with agile, experience design, technology and risk partners to achieve business and customer outcomes. In the case of technical products, understands and cares for the technical features, debt reduction and modernization of the technical product with expertise in the technology required of the product. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills: • Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators, design systems, service blueprints, and reusability. • Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value. • Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point. • Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products. • Knowledge of Agile ways of working, knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations. • Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, product discovery, product development, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, agile ways of working, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics, customer centricity. Minimum Qualifications: • Product management experience

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

author: Hiring Manager
title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.  
  
Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

* Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
* Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
* Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
* Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

#### **The Role:**

We’re looking for a product manager who thinks in systems, not features. Our team — including product admins and student success managers — handles a large and growing workload, and much of it is still manual: watching customer Slack channels, cross-referencing Google Sheets, catching escalations late, onboarding our students etc. Your job is to design the product and infrastructure that takes that load off people so they can focus on the work that actually matters.  
  
You’ll own the full picture: how the dashboard and interface fit together, how information flows between systems, and where AI can quietly do the heavy lifting. The bar is simple — every feature you ship should make someone’s day easier, never add cognitive load.  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who is product-minded with a real technical sense. Not a pure PM who hands off specs, and not a pure developer — someone who can talk to a user, sketch the flow in Figma, build a working prototype in Dify or n8n, and judge whether the result is genuinely good to use.

#### **What you’ll do**

* **Own the end-to-end experience.** Design the dashboard and interface as a coherent whole, not a collection of features. Understand how each screen, workflow, and data point connects, and keep the system simple as it grows.
* **Design for real users under real load.** Observe how team members work, find friction and repetitive effort, and design flows that streamline high-volume work. UX quality is a core deliverable, not a finishing touch.
* **Use AI to remove work, not create it.** Identify where LLMs, RAG, and automation can take tasks off people’s plates — triage, summarization, flagging, routing, follow-ups — and design those capabilities so they feel invisible and trustworthy.
* **Build a unified view of the customer journey.** Integrate conversations from customer Slack channels with our core applications and Google Sheets so the team sees one picture instead of many.
* **Make service proactive.** Build systems that automatically flag and triage customer escalations before they become critical, and that help student success managers identify at-risk clients and trigger timely, automated follow-ups.
* **Prototype and verify quickly.** Use Dify.AI to build LLM-powered prototypes, implement RAG, and iterate on prompts; use n8n to orchestrate automated workflows across third-party apps and APIs. Validate ideas with working prototypes before committing engineering time.
* **Lead AI product design.** Prompt engineering, model selection and configuration, interaction design for AI features, and an evaluation framework that tells us whether an AI feature is actually working.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Turn Pricing Into Perfect Matches

  

At Shaadi.com, we don’t just help people find love—we build products that make millions of journeys possible. We’re looking for a sharp, high-energy Product Manager to own our Pricing & Promotions pods, where every experiment, offer, and price point directly shapes growth, conversion, and revenue.
  
If you love decoding user behaviour, running high-impact experiments, and turning data into business wins, this role is your kind of match.

️What You’ll Own

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for pricing, promotions, offers, and monetisation initiatives across Shaadi.com.
* Design and launch pricing models, discounting strategies, subscription offers, and campaign-led promotions that drive conversions without compromising long-term value.
* Use analytics, A/B tests, and user research to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and measure impact on revenue, retention, and user experience.
* Partner closely with Tech, Design, Data, Marketing, Finance, and Business teams to ship initiatives end to end.
* Monitor key metrics—conversion, ARPU, revenue, uptake, churn, and margin—and translate insights into clear product decisions.
* Balance user delight with business outcomes: build offers that feel valuable to members while driving sustainable growth.

  

Who We’re Looking For

* 2–4 years of product management experience, ideally in pricing, promotions, growth, monetisation, or B2C product roles.
* Experience at a top consumer-facing organisation is strongly preferred—someone who understands scale, speed, and user-first thinking.
* MBA from a top B-school is preferred.
* High IQ, strong structured thinking, and the ability to simplify complex trade-offs quickly.
* Comfortable with data: funnels, cohorts, experiments, pricing elasticity, and business metrics.
* A builder’s mindset: proactive, ownership-driven, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited to ship fast.

Why Shaadi.com?

* Work on one of India’s most iconic consumer internet brands, with real impact on millions of users.
* Own high-visibility pricing and promotions pods where your decisions move the business.
* Be based in Mumbai, working onsite with product, tech, and business leaders.

job_description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world's manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that's you we would love to have you join us!

The SAFe **Product Manager,** Software leads the definition, prioritization, and execution of software and digital investments for an Agile Release Train (ART) in the **Power and Motion Business Portfolio** . You will be the primary connection between business strategy, customer and user needs, and software engineering execution, translating market opportunities and stakeholder requirements into actionable roadmaps, features, and release priorities. You will collaborate with commercial, product, architecture, engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and program leadership teams to guide investment decisions and ensure delivery of customer and business value.

You will report to the SAFe Team Lead and will work a hybrid schedule based in Pune, India.

  
  

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Develop and own the feature backlog and roadmap for software development according to portfolio priorities
* Manage alignment between Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), software architecture, and the Agile Release Train feature backlog
* Work with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to set implementation direction and balance priorities
* Coordinate with stakeholders outside the business segment on integration plans, dependencies, and release alignment with connected products and platforms
* Work with development teams to remove implementation barriers and coordinate resolution of technical, dependency, and delivery issues with the necessary stakeholders
* Guide the ART in achieving predictable, high-quality objectives by responding to issues, making timely decisions, and supporting release readiness
* Develop intuitive familiarity with the software portfolio, architecture, technology, R&D, customer workflows, and market factors to collaborate across technical and commercial teams
* Manage several simultaneous initiatives related to the effectiveness and flow of the Agile Release Train
* Support implementation of the global business unit product strategy and Annual Operating Plan
* Partner with Product Management to resolve complex internal and external customer problems with broad, long-term effects, responding with urgency and delivering cost-effective, high-quality solutions
  

  

### **The Essentials - You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field
* Willing to travel up to 10%
  

  

### **The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience
* In-depth knowledge of Agile methodologies and techniques, with experience supporting or leading an Agile Release Train
* Knowledge of industrial automation products and the software ecosystems that configure, connect, monitor, or support them
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation software, variable frequency drive, or motion product portfolios is highly desired
* Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, product management, software engineering, architecture, quality, and program teams
* Demonstrated success working within a global matrix environment to achieve multiple simultaneous goals
* Ability to communicate complex technical and business information clearly to multiple levels of stakeholders
* Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility
  

  

### **What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programmes through OnTrack
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* Other local benefits

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-HR1

  
  
  

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for a highly motivated Associate Product Manager (APM) with 1–3 years of experience in building and managing websites and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will support the end-to-end product lifecycle from requirement gathering to launch, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, business, QA, and account management.

You will play a key role in improving user experience, driving feature adoption, and ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. A keen eye for detail, user empathy, and a strong grasp of digital platforms are essential.

**Responsibilities:**

● Support the product roadmap and backlog for web and mobile platforms  
● Translate user needs and business goals into clear feature requirements and user stories ● Work with design and development teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution  
● Conduct user research, usability testing, and competitor benchmarking  
● Monitor product performance and user behavior using Google Analytics  
● Maintain clear product documentation, release notes, and training materials  
● Ensure alignment with business stakeholders and account managers, and provide regular updates on progress

**Required Skills and Traits:**

● Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field  
● 1–3 years of product experience in web and mobile app environments  
● Strong analytical skills and understanding of product metrics using Google Analytics  
● Experience with Zoho Sprints and familiarity with tools like JIRA, Figma, or Trello  
● Knowledge of project management and the complete product development lifecycle  
● Ability to lead ideation sessions and define clear user and business requirements  
● Good written and verbal communication skills  
● Experience working with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders  
● Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver product demos with clear understanding of functionality and user workflows

**Preferred Qualifications:**

● Prior involvement in consumer-facing digital platforms  
● Understanding of APIs, technical constraints, and platform differences  
● Experience working with cloud-based products or services is a plus  
● Certification in Product Management from recognized institutions (e.g., Airtribe, Product School, Hello PM or equivalent)

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your total experience in product maagement (except freelancing/part time roles) ?
* Are you currently residing or willing to relocate to Goa ?
* Are willing to work 6 days a week onsite (Goa) ?
* Please mention your current/last fixed CTC (in lacs per annum).
* Please mention your expected CTC (in lacs per annum).
* How soon can you join (please include your notice period and relocation time needed for joining) ?

Work Location: In person

job_description:
Designation: NA

Location: India Maharashtra Thane - GCorp

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own and investment products with a strong focus on Mutual Funds. The role will drive product strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, integrations and business outcomes across mobile and web platforms. The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in a digital investment platform, wealth-tech company, fintech, bank or broking environment, and a strong understanding of the mutual fund investment lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Mutual Fund Product Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end mutual fund product lifecycle across discovery, investment, servicing and portfolio management.
* Drive digital journeys for onboarding, KYC, risk profiling, lumpsum investments, SIP registration, mandate setup, purchase, redemption, switch, cancellation, SIP pause/modify and transaction tracking.
* Build and enhance fund discovery, scheme details, comparison, filters, portfolio views, performance analytics, goal-based investing and investor education features.
* Work on integrations with AMCs, RTAs, BSE StAR MF / relevant transaction platforms, payment gateways, banks and other ecosystem partners, as applicable.
* Improve funnel conversion, transaction success, SIP activation, repeat investments, AUM growth and customer retention.
* Ensure a seamless experience across direct and regular mutual fund propositions, where applicable.

**2. Digital Product Strategy & Execution**
-------------------------------------------

* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritisation and success metrics in line with business objectives and customer needs.
* Translate business requirements into BRDs, product requirement documents, user stories, use cases, process flows and acceptance criteria.
* Drive product discovery through customer insights, data analysis, market research and competitor benchmarking.
* Partner with UX/UI, engineering, QA, operations, compliance and business teams to deliver scalable and intuitive digital experiences.
* Lead sprint planning, backlog prioritisation, UAT, release management and post-launch monitoring.

**3. Wealth & Investment Products**
-----------------------------------

* Work across adjacent investment products such as equities, ETFs, fixed deposits, bonds, NCDs, NPS, digital gold, PMS and AIFs, based on business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to create integrated investment journeys, cross-sell relevant products and improve customer lifetime value.
* Collaborate with AMCs, banks, brokers, fintech partners and vendors for product launches and platform integrations.

**4. Analytics & Business Growth**
----------------------------------

* Define and track KPIs including visitor-to-investor conversion, KYC completion, SIP registrations, mandate success, order success, AUM, active investors and repeat transaction rates.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel drop-offs, cohorts and product usage to identify growth and experience improvements.
* Use experimentation, A/B testing and data-led prioritisation to optimise product journeys.
* Prepare product performance dashboards and business reviews for senior stakeholders.

**5. Regulatory, Risk & Compliance**
------------------------------------

* Work with compliance, legal and operations teams to translate applicable SEBI, AMFI, AMCs, RTA and other regulatory requirements into product features and controls.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures, risk profiling, suitability, consent, audit trails and transaction controls are incorporated into customer journeys.
* Support regulatory change implementation, issue resolution and applicable reporting requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 10–14 years of overall experience, with substantial hands-on product management experience in mutual funds or digital investment platforms.
* Strong understanding of the mutual fund lifecycle, including onboarding/KYC, fund discovery, purchase, SIP, mandates, redemption, switch, portfolio tracking and servicing.
* Experience owning digital products on mobile apps and/or web platforms, preferably in a high-volume consumer fintech or wealth-tech environment.
* Ability to define product strategy, write clear requirements, prioritise roadmaps and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with engineering, design, QA, operations, compliance, business teams and external technology partners.
* Strong product analytics, funnel analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Working knowledge of APIs, payment flows, integrations, Agile delivery and UAT.

**Preferred Company Background**
================================

Candidates from digital investment, wealth-tech, fintech, discount broking and online mutual fund platforms will be strongly preferred. Relevant target organisations may include:

* Groww
* Zerodha (especially Coin / mutual fund product teams)
* ET Money
* INDmoney
* Kuvera
* Paytm Money
* Upstox
* Angel One
* FundsIndia
* Scripbox
* Other comparable digital wealth or mutual fund investment platforms.

Important: Prior experience in one of the above companies is a sourcing preference, not a substitute for relevant product ownership. Candidates must have directly worked on mutual fund product features, journeys or platform enhancements. Experience limited to sales, relationship management, distribution or back-office operations without digital product ownership would not be sufficient for this role.

**Educational Qualifications**
==============================

* MBA / PGDM / MFM or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Management, Technology or a related discipline preferred.
* NISM or other relevant capital markets / mutual fund certifications will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================

* Growth in mutual fund investors, AUM and SIP registrations.
* Improvement in onboarding, KYC, mandate and transaction conversion rates.
* Order success rate, journey completion and reduction in customer drop-offs.
* Feature adoption, active usage, repeat investments and customer retention.
* On-time delivery of roadmap commitments and quality of product releases.
* Regulatory readiness and timely implementation of compliance requirements.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

**What you’ll do**

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

**What success looks like**

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

**Who you are**

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

**Qualifications**
------------------

2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.

A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.

Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).

Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.

Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.

Clear written and verbal communication.

**Strongly preferred**

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

**Good to have**

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Additional Information**  
Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

job_description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management

**General Summary:**

**Help shape the next generation of AI-powered mobile experiences.**

Qualcomm is seeking a **Staff Product Manager** within the Handset Business Unit to work at the intersection of **AI, software, silicon, and consumer experiences** . You will partner closely with customers to turn ambitious product ideas into compelling smartphone and personal AI experiences.

This is a highly customer-facing role for a product leader with **strong product intuition, AI fluency, and technical depth** . You will connect customer and consumer needs with Qualcomm’s hardware, software, and AI roadmaps, bring together teams across technology domains, and help shape the future of mobile computing.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

**Customer Product Leadership**

* Serve as the primary product management interface for assigned customers, developing a deep understanding of their product vision, architecture, requirements, and roadmap.
* Translate customer insights into product priorities and drive alignment across Qualcomm product, engineering, customer engineering, technical account management, and sales teams.

**Integrated Hardware and Software Strategy**

* Serve as the primary product management interface for the Handset Business Unit’s software strategy with assigned customers, connecting customer needs with Qualcomm’s software, AI, hardware, and technology roadmaps.
* Own integrated hardware and software roadmap communication and coordinate across technology product owners to deliver a coherent end-to-end strategy.

**System-Level Product Management**

* Develop a system-level understanding of smartphone and personal-device architectures across AI, camera, voice, audio, modem, graphics, software, and related technologies.
* Connect technology capabilities, dependencies, and trade-offs to the overall device architecture and consumer experience.

**AI and Product Strategy**

* Develop expertise in emerging consumer AI experiences and a strong point of view on what constitutes a compelling product experience.
* Translate customer, consumer, market, and technology insights into product, portfolio, and roadmap recommendations.

**Technology Ecosystem**

* Maintain a strong understanding of developments across AI/ML, software, infrastructure, and related ecosystem technologies.
* Evaluate internal and external capabilities against product requirements and contribute to build, partner, or buy decisions.

**Roadmap and Executive Communication**

* Communicate integrated product roadmaps and deliver strategic and technical presentations to customers, partners, internal stakeholders, and senior executives.
* Translate customer and market feedback into recommendations and drive cross-functional alignment on product priorities, dependencies, and decisions.

**Level of Responsibility**

* Works independently with little supervision, making significant-impact decisions in complex environments.
* Leads complex cross-functional initiatives and manages priorities across short- and long-term horizons.
* Communicates complex technical and strategic information to audiences with differing levels of expertise.
* Applies advanced analytical judgment and problem solving when information is incomplete or conflicting.
* Uses strong negotiation and influence skills to align customers, product teams, technology leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Exercises creativity and independent judgment to develop new approaches and solutions and influence key organizational decisions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payment Services (GPS), GPS INM Product team as Product Manager – Receivables.

**Job Introduction**

Manage the GPS INM receivables portfolio, encompassing UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect and structured B2B reconciliation products, including DART, ARR and third-party offerings. The role covers the end-to-end product lifecycle, from concept, development and enhancement to launch, maintenance and commercialisation. Working under the guidance of the Senior Product Manager, coordinate internal teams and external partners to deliver seamless client onboarding, effective collection and reconciliation solutions, robust supporting processes, sound product governance and a consistent client experience.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Manage the development, enhancement, launch, maintenance and ongoing performance of UPI, NACH, Virtual Accounts, Omni Collect, DART, ARR and other structured B2B and third-party reconciliation offerings.
* Translate client needs and business requirements into defined product designs, prioritised enhancements and actionable launch plans. Use market insights, competitor benchmarking and client feedback from Sales, Coverage and GPS teams to develop differentiated propositions, maintain a prioritised backlog and incorporate client validation and pilot feedback.
* Evaluate partnerships with acquiring providers, payment platforms and reconciliation solution providers. Coordinate IT, Operations, Client Management, GPS teams and external partners to deliver integrated client collection and reconciliation propositions, with clear ownership, agreed actions and appropriate partner due diligence and governance.
* Define and maintain end-to-end operating and service models covering client onboarding, production service continuity, collections, reconciliation, exception handling and ongoing servicing. Work with Operations and Client Management to document and agree workflows and resolve exceptions within agreed service timelines.
* Coordinate product deployments, enhancements, testing and launch readiness, with documented requirements and stakeholder approvals. Deliver assigned initiatives against agreed milestones and provide concise updates on priorities, progress, risks and decisions, escalating delivery dependencies promptly to the Senior Product Manager.
* Support commercialisation and client adoption through product collateral, sales enablement and ongoing enhancements. Partner with GPS and Coverage teams to convert client opportunities into suitable receivables solutions, tracking progress against agreed plans, product adoption and client usage.
* Ensure alignment with applicable regulatory guidelines and HSBC policies, internal controls and the Group Compliance Policy. Identify product, third-party and operational risks with risk stewards, coordinate controls and approvals, track mitigating actions and report losses appropriately. Support third-party assessments, regulatory reporting and client-issue resolution; monitor relevant collection, reconciliation and applicable partner chargeback/refund metrics; submit credit-risk exceptions and pricing decisions for approval; and ensure timely implementation of audit actions and resolution of regulator-raised issues.

**Role Requirements / Education Qualifications / Certifications / Experience:**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, or equivalent, with a university degree and/or relevant training qualifications.
* Demonstrated progressive experience and a proven track record in cash management, receivables and/or payments product development and management, or equivalent relevant experience, including product development, project management, fintech engagement and market- or client-facing banking functions.
* Corporate transaction banking or cash management experience is preferred, but not mandatory. Experience in merchant acquiring, UPI collections, NACH, Virtual Accounts or structured B2B reconciliation is preferred, but not mandatory; familiarity with DART, ARR or third-party reconciliation offerings is beneficial.
* Demonstrated project and programme management experience, including co-creating solutions with IT and internal business partners. Excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and deliver within tight deadlines.
* Ability to develop innovative, flexible solutions addressing client needs and to understand clients’ business models, operating needs and core business fundamentals. Sound business acumen and commercial awareness, including relevant economic, cultural, procedural and regulatory considerations.
* Strong interpersonal, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships. A collaborative approach to teamwork, supported by self-motivation and a proactive working style.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to develop well-founded recommendations for decision-making. Familiarity with emerging technologies is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including clear, compelling presentations. Fluency in English is expected; additional language skills are beneficial.

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**

**Additional Notes:**

Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to advance product initiatives and meet business objectives
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and support backlog creation
* Prioritize and re-evaluate requirements throughout the product lifecycle
* Understand the product strategy, roadmap, and future releases
* Break work into user stories and manageable tasks aligned to OKRs
* Create user flows, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done
* Drive backlog grooming and prioritization activities
* Understand team capacity, priorities, and impediments
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide constructive feedback
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in technology, computer science, mathematics, economics, statistics, physics, health informatics, business, marketing, or a related field; alternatively, a technical certification, bootcamp, or 2-year technical college qualification
* Analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to understand and analyze process flow diagrams
* Solid listening, communication, and collaboration skills
* Product-focused mindset

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with product management tools such as Aha!, Rally, and GitHub
* Understanding of personas and customer journeys
* Knowledge of healthcare industry processes and technology
* Familiarity with software development practices and Agile methodologies

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Manager to help shape and scale our EdTech platform for JEE, NEET, and board-exam aspirants. You will own one or more product areas — learning, assessments, content, or growth — and will drive the roadmap from discovery to launch across web, Android, and iOS. You will work closely with founders, engineering, design, content, and marketing teams to deliver products that measurably improve student outcomes and business metrics.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap for your product area and align it with business, content, and engineering

priorities.

* Talk to students, parents, teachers, and internal teams to deeply understand pain points and

learning behavior.

* Translate insights into clear PRDs, user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria.

* Partner with design on wireframes, prototypes, and user testing; partner with engineering on scope, trade-offs, and delivery.

* Define, instrument, and track success metrics — engagement, retention, conversion, learning outcomes, and revenue.

* Run A/B experiments on pricing, paywalls, onboarding, notifications, and content discovery — and make data-backed calls on what ships.

* Collaborate on our conversion funnel — from YouTube/Shorts traffic to free users to paid course subscribers.

* Own feature launches end-to-end — launch plans, GTM alignment, customer comms, and

post-launch monitoring.

* Prioritize ruthlessly using frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, impact-effort) and communicate priorities clearly to stakeholders.

* Use product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA, or similar) and work with data/BI to build dashboards for your area.

* Keep a close eye on the competitive landscape (Physics Wallah, Unacademy, Vedantu, etc.) and translate learnings into opportunities.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience in a consumer-facing product (preferably EdTech, mobile, or content platforms).

* Proven track record of shipping features that moved measurable business or user metrics.

* Strong user research skills — interviewing students/users, synthesizing insights, and turning

them into product decisions.

* Strong analytical skills and fluency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA) and basic SQL for self-serve data pulls.

* Hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests and interpreting results with statistical rigor.

* Experience writing clear PRDs, success criteria, and release plans that engineering and design teams can execute on.

* Strong understanding of conversion funnels, retention, and monetization patterns — especially freemium / tiered pricing.

* Comfort working closely with engineering on technical trade-offs — APIs, microservices, mobile constraints, performance.

* Experience shipping on mobile-first products (Android and iOS) and understanding

platform-specific nuances.

* Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp one-pager, present to founders, and debate trade-offs clearly.

* Bias for action, high ownership, and comfort navigating ambiguity.

**Good to Have**

* Prior experience in EdTech — particularly JEE/NEET/boards, K-12, or test-prep products.

* Experience building or scaling content-driven products (YouTube/Shorts funnels, creator-led GTM, live classes).

* Experience with assessments and test platforms — question banks, live tests, analytics on

student performance.

* Familiarity with growth loops, referrals, student ambassador programs, and community-led

growth.

* Exposure to live streaming products, push notification strategy, or

personalization/recommendations.

* Prior startup experience — 0®1 product building and operating in early/growth-stage

environments.

* MBA or equivalent structured business education (not required if experience is strong).

**What We're Looking For**

* Student-obsessed — you genuinely care about learning outcomes, not just feature velocity.

* First-principles thinker who can simplify complex problems and drive clarity for the team.

* Comfortable going from strategy to pixel-level detail in the same week.

* Data-driven, but not data-blind — you balance metrics with intuition and user empathy.

* Collaborative leader who earns trust across engineering, design, content, and marketing.

* High-agency — you spot problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.
* **Definition:** Drafting PRDs, generating user stories, mapping workflows, identifying dependencies, and stress-testing edge cases before handing requirements to engineering.
* **Design:** Creating wireframes, prototyping interfaces, exploring UI variants, and validating user flows using tools such as Figma AI, v0, Lovable, or Claude.
* **Build:** Translating requirements into technical specifications, understanding APIs and system architecture, debugging alongside engineers, and using AI to review code and understand implementation trade-offs.
* **Launch:** Generating release notes, preparing customer communications, creating product documentation, and enabling sales and implementation teams with feature updates.
* **Measure:** Querying product data, analysing adoption and turnaround times, identifying workflow bottlenecks, generating hypotheses, and using AI to accelerate product analysis.
* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

We don't expect you to be an engineer. We do expect you to be technically curious, resourceful, and capable of using modern AI tools to move faster and produce better work.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, legal-tech, or workflow automation.
* Experience owning an existing product and driving its roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business and customer requirements into structured product specifications.
* Experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical trade-offs, APIs, integrations, and software architecture.
* Excellent written communication. You should be able to write a clear PRD, explain a complex workflow, and communicate a product decision without ambiguity.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to prioritise opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and demanding enterprise customers without losing sight of the product roadmap.
* A bias towards execution. You should be someone who takes ownership, follows through, and gets things shipped.
* Genuine interest in AI tools and a willingness to experiment with them as part of your everyday workflow.

**An added advantage:** Experience with legal workflows, arbitration, mediation, BFSI, lending, collections, grievance redressal, regulatory technology, or high-volume transaction platforms.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Leader / Product Manager -SDS2
job_description:
**Company Description**

The Nemetschek Group is a leading global vertical software and AI provider driving the digital transformation of the AEC/O and media industries. With our deep domain expertise and intelligent, connected software solutions, we enable customers to turn data into real-time insights and smarter decisions throughout the entire lifecycle of buildings and infrastructure from ideation through planning, visualization, construction, operation, and renovation.  
Our AI-powered technologies and open standards approach boost productivity, collaboration, and sustainability for architects, engineers, contractors, building operators, and creative professionals. Over 7 million users worldwide rely on our customer-centric, human-led AI solutions. Founded by Professor Georg Nemetschek in 1963, today we employ over 4,000 experts globally across 14 subsidiaries.

 **Job Description**

What we are looking for

We are hiring a **Product Manager for SDS2** who combines strong product-management fundamentals with practical understanding of **structural steel fabrication, detailing, or manufacturing**. This is not intended to be a general-purpose software PM role.

The ideal candidate understands how engineering software fits into real fabrication workflows and has an **AI-first mindset**, actively looking for ways AI can improve detailing, automation, decision-making, user productivity, and the way we build products.

Industry & Technical Background

* Strong experience with **structural steel fabrication, steel detailing, manufacturing, or closely related industrial engineering workflows**
* Ability to communicate credibly with detailers, fabricators, engineers, developers, and customers
* Bachelor's degree in **engineering, architecture, or a closely related technical field**
* Understanding of complex engineering/manufacturing workflows and the ability to translate them into software requirements

Product Management

* Ideally **5+ years of Product Management / Product Ownership experience**, preferably with AEC, engineering, manufacturing, or technical B2B software
* Demonstrated ownership of:
  + Product vision and roadmap
  + Customer discovery and requirements
  + Epics and backlog prioritization
  + Agile product development
  + Product lifecycle
  + Market and competitive analysis
  + Product launches / GTM
  + Product metrics and business outcomes
* Strong project-management capability across distributed, cross-functional teams
* Excellent written, verbal, and customer-facing communication skills
* Comfortable working directly with Engineering, UX, Sales, Support, Marketing, customers, and senior leadership.
* **Jira** for requirements, epics, backlog, and Agile development
* **Basecamp** for project/program coordination
* Customer-facing product discovery
* Structural engineering knowledge
* Fabrication shop experience
* BIM / digital fabrication workflows
* APIs, interoperability, or integrations
* Enterprise B2B software experience
* Data-driven product management

AI-First Mindset

We want someone who views **AI as a fundamental part of the future of SDS2**, not simply another feature.

Look for candidates who:

* Routinely use AI tools in their own work
* Understand practical applications of **AI/ML, copilots, agents, automation, or intelligent workflows**
* Can identify repetitive or knowledge-intensive detailing tasks that could be automated or augmented
* Can translate AI opportunities into customer problems, workflows, requirements, and measurable outcomes
* Are curious and willing to experiment rather than waiting for established industry solutions

Direct AI product experience is highly desirable but should **not outweigh steel-industry/domain knowledge**.

Strong Differentiators

Experience with one or more of the following should move a candidate **significantly higher in the recruiting funnel**:

**Steel / Detailing Software**

* SDS2
* Tekla Structures
* Advance Steel
* Bocad
* ProSteel
* Other structural steel detailing / fabrication systems

**Engineering / Manufacturing Software**

* SolidWorks
* Autodesk Inventor
* Creo
* CATIA
* Bentley engineering products
* Other CAD/CAM/CAE, BIM, PLM, or fabrication software

  
**Additional Information**

#NemetschekIndia #LI-Hybrid #LI-NB1

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager, 1
job_description:
**Job Title**

Senior Product Manager, 1

**Job Description**

**Mandatory Skills**  

* Regularly review reports specific to your domains in order to monitor health, revenue, and other important KPIs.
* At least 4-5 years of hands-on product management—day-to-day product ownership. Demonstrable experience leading and participating in product management initiatives.
* Have owned product lifecycle at key junctures: ideation, vision, requirements, roadmap, specifications, analysis, and iteration.
* You think at scale and have experience launching products in new areas with ambiguity.
* Product experience with web applications/SPAs; native app experience is a nice to have
* You have sound business judgment, proven ability to influence others, and strong analytical skills.
* You possess a passion for figuring out user problems, are able to work iteratively, and have a bias for action.
* You’re excellent at communicating and collaborating with a wide range of teams and stakeholders to build great products.
* You have experience with data driven product development and possess a knowledge of agile methodologies.
* You can tell stories through data.
* You know how to talk to users and extract meaningful insights through best practice research methods.
* Strong interest/knowledge of stock markets
* Comfortable working with databases, including querying and analyzing data to inform product decisions.

  
**Good to Have:**  
Technical expertise in Full stack development which will help to have conversation, understand pain points from developers perspective.  
  
**What will you learn on this job?**  
You will work closely with brand leaders, editorial team members, other product managers and drive, execute product strategy for the largest digital publisher company in the US.  
  
**Designation**: Senior Product Manager, 1  
**Working Hours**: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST  
**Location**: Ecoworld, Bengaluru, Karnataka

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager – Keysight EDA Solutions (S)
job_description:
We are looking for a technically competent and business-oriented Keysight EDA Product Manager responsible for driving sales growth, market development, product positioning, and customer engagement for Keysight Electronic Design Automation solutions.

The role involves identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic accounts, working closely with Keysight OEM teams, supporting technical sales activities, and achieving revenue targets across key industries.

  

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Product Management & Business Development**

* Drive sales and revenue growth for Keysight EDA solutions.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets, and product growth strategies.
* Identify new customers and emerging markets for RF, microwave, wireless, and semiconductor design solutions.
* Build and manage sales pipelines and forecast opportunities.
