job_description:
**Product Manager – Ad Decisioning Enablement**  
  
**Roundel, Target’s Retail Media Network**  
  
**About us**  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  
  
**Team Overview**  
  
Roundel is Target’s retail media network, helping brands connect with millions of Target guests through relevant, measurable, and guest-centered advertising experiences.  
  
As retail media continues to grow, advertisers are looking for smarter ways to plan, activate, optimize, and measure their investments. Roundel is investing in next-generation intelligence products that help teams and advertisers make better media decisions across channels, campaign stages, and business objectives.  
  
We are looking for a **Product Manager** to lead a high-impact area focused on **ad-inventory forecasting** and **ad-relevance** capabilities  
  
In this role, you will shape capabilities that enable our ad-decisioning engine elevate customer experience and deliver advertiser outcomes. This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and building systems that translate complex signals into decision drivers  
  
You will partner closely with data science, engineering, analytics, and product teams to define the strategy, roadmap, and execution for capabilities that help Roundel deliver more effective, and measurable advertising outcomes.  
  
**What you’ll do**

  

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for ad-inventory forecasting and ad-relevance.
* Working at the intersection of data, AI, and business, you’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, and partner teams to design scalable systems and intelligent models.
* Collaborate with sales, GTM and other product teams to ensure these products translate into real-world value for advertisers, and to continuously refine based on adoption, performance, and market feedback.
* As part of Roundel, Target’s retail media business, play a pivotal role in advancing the sophistication of our forecasting, optimization, and recommendation engines.
* Influence how advertisers plan, invest, and win on Target’s platform — impacting both advertiser success and Target’s bottom line.

**What we’re looking for**

  

* Experience: 4+ years of Product Management, ideally with a focus on data-driven, optimization, or AI/ML-powered products in adtech, martech, or related fields.
* Technical fluency: Comfortable working with data science, machine learning, experimentation, or AI-driven systems; able to bridge technical depth with business application.
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of retail media networks, digital advertising ecosystems, or media buying workflows is a strong plus.
* Cross-functional leadership: Proven ability to partner with data engineers, scientists, API developers, and commercial teams to bring complex products to market.
* Analytical strength: Skilled at interpreting large datasets, validating accuracy, and turning complex signals into actionable decisions.
* AI curiosity: Experience (or strong interest) in GenAI/agentic AI and applying emerging technologies to improve forecasting, optimization, and recommendations.
* Strategic mindset: Able to set product vision, establish OKRs, and drive execution across multiple dependencies in a fast-moving space.
* Influence & storytelling: Excellent communicator who can distil technical complexity into compelling narratives for sales, advertisers, and executives.
* Organized & adaptable: Adept at managing priorities, navigating ambiguity, and iterating quickly based on feedback and results.
* A bias for action, curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a passion for building products that create measurable impact.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

job_description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**

At Tekion, we're transforming the automotive retail experience through our cloud-native platform, ARC — a modern, intelligent Dealer Management System (DMS) built for the future. We connect OEMs, dealerships, and consumers through powerful, AI-driven solutions that streamline operations, improve profitability, and elevate the customer experience.

The Parts Management module is a core component of ARC, enabling dealerships to efficiently manage warehouse inventory, fulfill service demand, and grow their retail and wholesale parts businesses. We're investing in intelligent, AI-powered capabilities to simplify complex workflows, improve decision-making, and drive operational productivity.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Product Manager II** to join our Parts Product team and help build the next generation of B2B wholesale, warehouse/inventory management, and AI-powered product capabilities.

In this role, you'll own key product capabilities across wholesale order management, fulfillment, and inventory operations, while identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation to solve complex business problems.

You'll work closely with customers, Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, and cross-functional partners to discover opportunities, define scalable solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings strong product ownership, analytical thinking, customer empathy, and a bias for action, along with **hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered product features** in B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own product capabilities end-to-end:** Drive discovery, requirements, prioritization, development, launch, and adoption for defined wholesale, warehouse/inventory management, and AI-powered workflows.

* **Build AI-powered product experiences:** Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, intelligent automation, and predictive insights to simplify workflows, improve decision-making, and enhance user productivity.

* **Solve meaningful customer problems:** Engage with dealership users, enterprise customers, and internal stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify root causes, and translate insights into scalable product solutions.

* **Shape product direction:** Partner with product leadership to contribute to roadmap priorities, evaluate opportunities, and make informed trade-offs based on customer and business impact.

* **Drive product execution:** Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, and AI/ML teams to define clear requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and deliver high-quality solutions.

* **Build for scale:** Design intuitive, efficient workflows supporting high-volume wholesale transactions, order fulfillment, inventory visibility, and multi-location operations.

* **Deliver measurable outcomes:** Define and track product success metrics, including adoption, operational efficiency, fulfillment accuracy, AI effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.

* **Champion product quality and customer success:** Partner with implementation, support, and customer-facing teams to ensure successful launches, resolve critical product gaps, and continuously improve the customer experience.

* **Bring market and technology insights:** Stay informed about B2B wholesale distribution, warehouse/inventory management, generative AI, AI agents, and emerging enterprise technologies to identify product innovation opportunities.

**What You'll Bring**

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**, preferably including hands-on product management and ownership of B2B SaaS or enterprise software capabilities.

* **Hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered product features**, with demonstrated ability to translate business problems into practical AI use cases and measurable customer value.

* Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent automation, including an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and applicability to enterprise workflows.

* Strong understanding of at least one relevant domain: wholesale distribution, order management, warehouse/inventory management, supply chain, logistics, or commerce.

* Demonstrated ability to independently drive product features from problem discovery through delivery, launch, and adoption.

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex workflows, prioritize opportunities, and make data-informed decisions.

* Experience translating business problems into clear product requirements, user experiences, and actionable engineering deliverables.

* Ability to collaborate with Engineering and AI/ML teams to evaluate AI solution feasibility, define success criteria, and ensure reliable, scalable product experiences.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

* A customer-first mindset, strong accountability, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with vertical SaaS or enterprise applications supporting industry-specific operational workflows.

* Experience building AI-powered enterprise solutions, including AI copilots, agentic workflows, intelligent recommendations, or automation, with familiarity in LLMs, RAG, and AI evaluation frameworks.

* Product management experience in warehouse/inventory management, procurement, supply chain, order management, or ERP systems.

* Knowledge of automotive dealership operations, dealership management systems (DMS), or automotive parts management.

* Experience with integrations and workflows spanning multiple functional areas within an enterprise platform.

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

For more information on our privacy practices, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice

***Important****: Tekion will only contact candidates from an @**tekion.com* *email address or through our applicant tracking system (no-reply@ashbyhq.com). We may also work with authorized recruiting partners from time to time. Tekion and its recruiting partners will never ask you to pay fees or send money for applications, interviews, training, or onboarding. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, please do not respond or share personal or financial information.*

title: Senior Product Manager – Private Markets, Data & Feeds
job_description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Product Manager to lead the growth and execution of our **Private Markets Data & Feeds proposition** . This role will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy, commercial roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives for private markets datasets across asset classes including Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Infrastructure, and Real Assets.

The successful candidate will act as the intersection between clients, sales, content, technology, and strategic partners to deliver data products that meet the evolving needs of institutional investors, quantitative researchers, asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and alternative investment firms.

This is a highly visible role with responsibility for driving revenue growth, client adoption, product innovation, and market positioning within a rapidly expanding private markets ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.
* Gather competitive intelligence and monitor developments across private markets, alternative investments, and data providers.

### **Product Development & Execution**

* Partner closely with data Strategy, engineering, data operations, and delivery teams to prioritize product enhancements.
* Define requirements for data models, coverage expansion, feed structures, APIs, cloud delivery, and integration capabilities.
* Drive agile product development processes and ensure successful product launches.
* Monitor client feedback and usage analytics to identify product improvement opportunities.

### **Commercial & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through value propositions, positioning, competitive messaging, and sales collateral.
* Support major commercial opportunities, RFPs, strategic negotiations, and client onboarding activities.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and targeted growth plans for key client segments.
* Establish KPIs and monitor adoption, retention, revenue growth, and client satisfaction.

### **Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop strategic relationships with private market participants, data providers, technology platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and support acquisition, partnership, and investment initiatives.
Drive integration and commercialization of third-party datasets where appropriate.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Product Strategy, Market Data, Financial Information Services, or Alternative Investments.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets, including:
  + - M&A
  + - Equity New Issues
  + - Debt New issues
  + - Loans
  + - Repurchases
  + - Joint Venture
  + - Shareholder Activism
  + - Poinson Pill
  + - Municipals
  + - Sustainable Finance
  + - Private Equity
  + - Private Credit
  + - Real Assets
  + - Fund performance & Benchmarking
* Experience managing enterprise data products, data feeds, APIs, or cloud-based data distribution platforms.
* Demonstrated success driving product growth and commercial outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple teams and senior leadership levels.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and client-facing skills.

* Experience within financial data providers, exchanges, investment research firms, alternative data vendors, or private markets technology platforms.
* Deep knowledge of institutional investor workflows and investment research processes.
* Familiarity with cloud data delivery platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of quantitative investment workflows and data integration requirements.

**Career Stage:**

Manager  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

  
  

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

  

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.

  
  

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

  
  

***LSEG. Make more possible.***

------------------------

### **Product Strategy & Commercial Leadership**

* Define and execute the commercial strategy for the Private Markets Data & Feeds business.
* Develop product vision, roadmap, and business cases aligned with client demand and market trends.
* Identify new revenue opportunities through new content offerings, delivery channels, partnerships, and licensing models.
* Establish pricing, packaging, and commercialization strategies to maximize market penetration and profitability.
* Own product P&L, growth targets, and business performance metrics.

### **Client & Market Engagement**

* Engage directly with Investment Banking, buy-side, sell-side, wealth, and research clients to understand current and emerging use cases.
* Translate client requirements into scalable product capabilities and data solutions.
* Represent the business externally at client meetings, industry conferences, webinars, and strategic forums.
* Gather competitive intelligence and monitor developments across private markets, alternative investments, and data providers.

### **Product Development & Execution**

* Partner closely with data Strategy, engineering, data operations, and delivery teams to prioritize product enhancements.
* Define requirements for data models, coverage expansion, feed structures, APIs, cloud delivery, and integration capabilities.
* Drive agile product development processes and ensure successful product launches.
* Monitor client feedback and usage analytics to identify product improvement opportunities.

### **Commercial & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Enable Sales and Customer Success teams through value propositions, positioning, competitive messaging, and sales collateral.
* Support major commercial opportunities, RFPs, strategic negotiations, and client onboarding activities.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and targeted growth plans for key client segments.
* Establish KPIs and monitor adoption, retention, revenue growth, and client satisfaction.

### **Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop strategic relationships with private market participants, data providers, technology platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy opportunities and support acquisition, partnership, and investment initiatives.
Drive integration and commercialization of third-party datasets where appropriate.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Science, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Commercial Product Strategy, Market Data, Financial Information Services, or Alternative Investments.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets, including:
  + - M&A
  + - Equity New Issues
  + - Debt New issues
  + - Loans
  + - Repurchases
  + - Joint Venture
  + - Shareholder Activism
  + - Poinson Pill
  + - Municipals
  + - Sustainable Finance
  + - Private Equity
  + - Private Credit
  + - Real Assets
  + - Fund performance & Benchmarking
* Experience managing enterprise data products, data feeds, APIs, or cloud-based data distribution platforms.
* Demonstrated success driving product growth and commercial outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across multiple teams and senior leadership levels.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and client-facing skills.

* Experience within financial data providers, exchanges, investment research firms, alternative data vendors, or private markets technology platforms.
* Deep knowledge of institutional investor workflows and investment research processes.
* Familiarity with cloud data delivery platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of quantitative investment workflows and data integration requirements.

Manager

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Powering the agentic revolution in travel.** Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

**Role Overview**  
  
**As part of the Sabre Payments team, this Senior Product Manager will lead the definition, execution, and delivery of strategic payment initiatives critical to scaling Sabre’s global business. Operating at the core intersection of travel and modern financial technology, the role bridges commercial strategy and technical engineering to build robust, scalable payment capabilities. The successful candidate will resolve complex product challenges creatively to deliver high-impact solutions for our project teams, broader department, and travel partners. In doing so, this position directly advances Sabre’s overarching strategic vision of powering next-generation travel retailing and seamless transaction workflows worldwide.**

  

**2. What THIS ROLE Will Do**

* **Product Strategy & Requirement Translation:** Serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, translating high-level business goals into actionable functional specifications, technical requirements, and detailed user stories.
* **End-to-End Delivery & Execution:** Own and drive the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle across cross-functional engineering and design teams, ensuring features are delivered on schedule and directly impact the success of the project team, department, and clients.
* **Creative Problem-Solving & Technical Alignment:** Resolve a wide range of complex product and integration challenges through creative, scalable technical solutions, maintaining high quality and operational reliability.
* **Stakeholder Influence & Cross-Functional Networking:** Proactively network and collaborate with senior internal teams (engineering, architecture, commercial) and external partners/vendors within your domain of expertise to align priorities and clear project roadmaps.
* **Team Guidance & Best Practices:** Act as a fully qualified domain practitioner, mentoring junior product associates or team members on product management best practices, backlog grooming, and Agile methodologies where applicable.

  

**3. What THIS ROLE Requires**

* **Relevant Experience:** 5 years of dedicated product management experience partnering directly with engineering teams to define, build, and deliver customer-facing or platform products and capabilities.
* **Technical & Analytical Acumen:** Strong experience decomposing complex workflows into clear user stories, API/technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and roadmap milestones within Agile/Scrum environments.
* **Proven Delivery & Creative Problem Solving:** Demonstrated track record of independently resolving multifaceted product challenges in creative ways to drive measurable project and business outcomes.
* **Stakeholder & Influence Skills:** Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to network, build alignment, and present effectively across both senior technical leadership and commercial stakeholders.
* **Domain Knowledge (Preferred):** Prior domain experience in digital payments, fintech gateways/processing, or the travel technology ecosystem is a strong plus

  

**4. Why Join Us**

* **Lead at the Intersection of Travel & Fintech:** Directly contribute to architecting and scaling a high-growth travel fintech ecosystem that processes transactions across the global travel marketplace.
* **Innovation & Cutting-Edge Tech:** Join Sabre at the forefront of AI-driven transformation, leveraging modern platforms and intelligent automation to reshape how the world travels and transacts.
* **Autonomous Impact & Visibility:** Step into a "fully qualified" L10 role with meaningful ownership over strategic initiatives, where your solutions have a direct line of sight to client success and departmental growth.
* **Collaborative Culture & Growth:** Work within a collaborative, globally distributed team that champions knowledge sharing, continuous mentorship, and clear pathways for senior product leadership advancement.

  

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: PRODUCT MANAGER III
job_description:
TE Connectivity's Product Management Teams manage all aspects of a product, from driving new product development to manufacturing to marketing. They are responsible for overall product strategy, business leadership and capacity plans in order to meet sales and profit targets.

**Responsibilties**
-------------------

**Market Sensing & Strategy Development:**
  

* Research market trends, demand drivers, customer needs, industry trends, and competitive landscape
* Conduct competitive analysis and benchmarking
* Conduct market segmentation exercises to define segment specific value propositions to beat competition.
* Develop product roadmaps that aligns with business strategy
* Design go to market strategy
* Work with R&D and operations in the development of new products to meet current and future customer requirements

**Develop Business Plan**
  

* Define resource requirements necessary to execute the product roadmap
* Work cross functionally to achieve sales, technology and operations strategies and goals, in line with financial goals.
* Establish pricing strategy
* Develop the annual operating plan (Sales and gross margin)

**Execution – New Product Development & Launch**
  

* Be the opportunity champion for development projects
* Attend customer meetings in support of winning new business
* Plans product launches, including the development of marketing and sales plans
* Gather product specification and product attribute information for the development of marketing collateral, including e-catalog

**Execution – Post Launch Product Management**
  

* Manage the P&L (sales and gross margin) for the assigned portfolio
* Deliver sustained profitable growth
* Enable sales to promote product line via training and the development of collateral materials that help articulate the value proposition
* Manage special price requests
* Track progress to the business plan and facilitate resolution to gaps
* Be the champion for resolution of product issues (e.g., quality, delivery, etc.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* 7 years of product management, development engineering or field application engineering experience
* 4-year technical degree required, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering degree preferred

* Relevant product or industry experience desired

**Additional Qualification**
----------------------------

* Strong business acumen with an ability to understand technically complex concepts
* Creative and innovative thinker
* Proven ability to multi-task and drive results in a dynamic, high paced environment
* Strong interpersonal, planning, organization, and teamwork skills
* Ability to influence cross functional teams and to build strong relationships both internally and externally

* Comfortable presenting complex concepts in a group setting

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally between 10%-25%

**Competencies**
----------------

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

**ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY**

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

  

**WHAT TE CONNECTIVITY OFFERS:**
  
We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!

* Competitive Salary Package
* Performance-Based Bonus Plans
* Health and Wellness Incentives
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
* Employee Resource Group

  

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
  
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from** **actual** **email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

**Job Locations:**

Kundalahalli Village, K.R. Puram Hobli
  
Bangalore, Karnātaka 560037
  
India

Job Country: India

Travel Required: 10% to 25%

**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

**Position Overview and Objective**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to oversee our network appliance and fleet management infrastructure.

The Senior Product Manager: Network Appliance will contribute to our Product Management organization by leading the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the applications and capabilities we deploy and support on our network appliance platform as well as the infrastructure required to manage our fleet at scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the applications and capabilities deployed and supported on the platform.

* Drive Datapath capabilities, including IDS, syslog ingestion & pre-parsing, network ML.

* Own on premises features that bridge Arctic Wolf’s cloud to the customer environment via the network appliance platform.

* Define and own licensing, entitlement & SKU structure for product and service sales and pricing.

* Own the customer portal and public APIs, including the customer user experience and interaction with our products and services through both the customer portal and public API usage.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of software on the fleet – from imaging and configuration, to release management and device upgrades, to fleet-wide monitoring and operations.

* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for appliance imaging & configuration, including build processes, manufacturer infrastructure deployment, fleet configuration & feature flag management, and zero-touch provisioning.

* Own release management & device upgrades, including fleet rollout practices, containerized application delivery systems (e.g., Docker, ECR) as a reusable platform capability, and the over-the-air (OTA) upgrade experience.

* Own the base OS lifecycle for our Linux RTK OS – major version migration planning, patch cadence, and LTS/EOL policy, and the upgrade infrastructure for the existing fleet.

* Drive fleet management capabilities: dashboards, telemetry aggregation and analysis, and fleet-level configuration and feature-flag operations. Building product features to ensure the scalability and maintainability of our fleet.

* Own vulnerability and CVE patch management, including the field escalation feedback loop from Support & Security teams and engineering.

* Partner with Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, to translate strategic initiatives into executable engineering plans for a dedicated feature team.

* Partner with peer product managers to ensure network appliance platform capabilities support the deployment and monitoring of your roadmap initiatives.

* Collaborate with sales on new feature and configuration support.

* Author and maintain detailed functional and technical specifications in product briefs and requirement documents, and support backlog grooming and sprint planning.

Conduct competitive and technical research to inform roadmap decisions and differentiate our appliance services offering.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**

* 10+ years of prior product management experience, ideally in network security, cybersecurity, or appliance/edge software.

* Engineering or technical background, such as Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Software Engineering.

* Experience with network detection/datapath technologies, API design, or licensing/entitlement systems.

* Experience with Jira, agile planning tools, and product analytics platforms.
Good To Have: Experience with intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, or deception technology.  

  

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

**Mott MacDonald** is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.

  

We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.

Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be **brilliant**.

**Job Description:**

  

We are creating a new Group People Technology function to provide clear ownership, governance and strategic direction across the technology that supports our global People services.

  

The People Technology Foundation Product Manager will provide accountable ownership for the People Foundation portfolio, ensuring that core workforce data, employee lifecycle capabilities, organisational structures and supporting technologies are governed, prioritised, optimised and developed in line with business priorities.

  

Reporting to the Group People Technology Manager, you will work closely with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead, Senior Product Specialists, Project Managers and colleagues across the wider function. You will work with People teams, business regions, IT, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, external partners and suppliers across a portfolio initially comprising SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include capabilities such as Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation services.

  

You will own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog, performance and continual improvement of the Foundation portfolio, ensuring it delivers measurable business value today while evolving to meet future organisational needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the People Technology Foundation product strategy, roadmap, backlog and priorities, ensuring investment and delivery remain aligned to business objectives and long-term technology direction.
* Act as the accountable owner for the Foundation portfolio, including SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and OpenText, with future scope expected to include Time Off, Absence Management and related Foundation capabilities.
* Balance immediate operational priorities with quarterly objectives, 12-18 month roadmap commitments and longer-term capability evolution, ensuring the portfolio delivers measurable value today while supporting future organisational needs.
* Lead and develop the Foundation product team, providing direction, coaching, prioritisation and performance management while building product, platform and delivery capability across the Foundation domain.
* Partner with the People Technology Portfolio & Operations Lead and participate in intake, demand and prioritisation processes, assessing Foundation-related incidents, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and project requests.
* Own delivery outcomes across the Foundation portfolio, determining the most appropriate delivery approach through internal capability, blended delivery teams and partner-led delivery models.
* Define expected benefits, success measures and business outcomes, monitoring value realisation to ensure technology investment delivers measurable benefit.
* Own the Foundation product data model, configuration, business rules and information structures, ensuring workforce data structures support business processes, reporting, compliance, workforce planning and future capability requirements.
* Build strong relationships with regional and global stakeholders, balancing local requirements with global standards, strategic priorities and product direction.
* Lead and develop the Foundation People Technology Community, creating structured engagement, feedback, knowledge-sharing and adoption mechanisms across regions and stakeholder groups.
* Drive adoption of leading practices across the Foundation portfolio, continuously assessing technology developments, market trends and industry approaches to improve product performance, user experience and business value.
* Monitor product health, service performance, adoption, usability and operational effectiveness, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and optimisation.
* Remain accountable for the quality, completeness and maintenance of Foundation product documentation, ensuring governance, audit, support and operational requirements are met.
* Own product relationships with support and delivery partners, reviewing commitments and outcomes, challenging recommendations where appropriate and driving effective knowledge transfer to build internal capability.
* Partner with architecture, security, data and integration teams to ensure solutions remain sustainable, compliant and aligned to enterprise standards and future technology direction.
  

**Candidate Specification:**

  

**Essential**

  

* Significant experience managing enterprise technology products, platforms or services within a complex organisation.
* Significant hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central, including product ownership, roadmap planning, capability development and stakeholder management.
* Experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, backlogs and priorities for enterprise technology products.
* Experience leading and developing product, platform, systems or technology teams, with responsibility for performance, coaching, prioritisation and capability development.
* Experience translating business requirements, operational challenges and strategic objectives into product outcomes and measurable value.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes, organisational structures, employee lifecycle processes and Foundation capabilities.
* Experience managing product demand, defects, enhancements, optimisation opportunities and investment decisions within a structured governance framework.
* Experience working with business stakeholders, regional teams, technology teams and third-party suppliers to deliver business outcomes.
* Experience managing partner-delivered services and balancing delivery through internal teams, blended teams and external providers.
* Strong stakeholder leadership, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to challenge constructively, build consensus and operate effectively at senior leadership level.
* Experience operating within a product-led delivery model and establishing governance, product processes and ways of working within new, evolving or transforming technology environments.
* Ability to balance immediate operational priorities with medium and long-term product strategy and roadmap planning.
* Experience using product performance, service performance, stakeholder feedback and business outcomes to drive continuous improvement and investment decisions.
  

**Desirable:**

  

* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications.
* Experience within People Technology, HR Technology or enterprise business application portfolios.
* Experience supporting OpenText or enterprise document and records management solutions.
* Experience supporting Time Off, Absence Management or Workforce Administration capabilities.
* Experience supporting Payroll technologies, payroll integrations or payroll-related HR processes.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, operating model change or organisational mobilisation initiatives.
* Experience developing and leading communities of practice, user groups, super-user networks or People Technology Communities.
* Experience with application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management or service governance.
* Experience working within a global, complex or matrixed organisation.
  

**Qualifications & Certifications - Desirable**

**Product**

  

* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Certification
* Additional SAP SuccessFactors certifications, particularly Employee Central Payroll, Time Management, Platform Foundations or Position Management.
  

**Product & Delivery**

* SAFe Product Manager / Product Owner
* AgilePM
* Scrum Product Owner
* Scrum Master

**Service Management**

ITIL Foundation or higher certification

  

**Flexible working**
  
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

  

**Our benefits package is designed to enhance your experience:**

* Agile working
* Critical illness and compassionate leave
* Paternity Leave
* Group term life insurance, and Group medical insurance coverage
* Career mobility options
* Short and Long-term global employment opportunities
* Global collaboration and knowledge sharing
  

**Employment Compliance Requirement**

As part of our global compliance requirements, all candidates must hold a valid Right to Work (RTW) document in India, which will be verified during the recruitment process.
  
**Acceptable documents include a Passport, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate.**
  
By applying, you **confirm** that you can provide valid documentation if and when required.

title: R&D Data Product Manager
job_description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en)
  
Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?
  
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

**Purpose and Scope:**

The R&D Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma R&D domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner.
  
The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
* Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
* Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
* Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
* Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
* Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
* Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness expectations into domain planning.
* Define product initiation and handoff criteria; identify and onboard the accountable Data Product Owner before detailed product delivery begins.
* Transition each approved product's delivery backlog, acceptance criteria, releases, consumer engagement, adoption, and ongoing lifecycle management to its Data Product Owner; provide portfolio-level coordination thereafter.
* Facilitate domain planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews and cross-team dependency forums with Core and Value Teams.
* Serve as Value Team (VT) captain to align team objectives with approved domain priorities, facilitate planning and progress reviews, coordinate commitments and dependencies, and escalate risks and decisions.
* Where assigned, perform Scrum Master responsibilities, including facilitating Scrum events, supporting impediment resolution, coaching the team in Scrum practices and enabling continuous improvement.
* Monitor domain-level business value, roadmap progress, adoption, reuse, and bottlenecks; recommend adjustments and improvements to the operating model and ways of working.
* Support cross-domain alignment and portfolio scaling while preserving the Data Domain Owner's authority over outcomes, investments, and major prioritization decisions.

job_description:
**Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain**

**Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting**

**About the Role**

**The Team**

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

**Position Summary**

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

* **Use case discovery beyond the original ask:** Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

* **Stakeholder alignment & adoption:** Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

* **Value realization & measurement:** Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

* **Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets:** Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

* 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

* Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

* Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

* Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

**Core Competencies**

* Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

* Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

* Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

* Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

* Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

* Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

* Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

* Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

* Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

* Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

* Executive presence and client-facing credibility to lead business conversations with senior stakeholders while working fluidly with engineering and product teams in the same engagement

* Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client-facing materials and business cases, lead discovery workshops, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Company: Curavea Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Department: Product Management

Designation: Product Manager

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager for our pharmaceutical business. The candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing product strategies, managing product portfolios, supporting sales and marketing activities, and driving brand growth in the market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Brand Management

* Manage the company's pharmaceutical product portfolio.
* Develop brand strategies to increase product sales and market share.
* Plan and execute new product launches.
* Identify opportunities for existing product growth.

2. Market Research & Analysis

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis.
* Monitor competitor brands, pricing, products and promotional activities.
* Identify market trends and new business opportunities.
* Analyse product performance and sales reports.

3. Sales & Marketing Support

* Develop marketing strategies and promotional plans for pharmaceutical products.
* Prepare visual aids, product presentations, product literature and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with RSMs, DSMs and the sales team to improve product performance.
* Provide product knowledge and scientific training to the sales team.
* Develop strategies for doctor engagement and prescription generation.

4. New Product Development

* Identify potential molecules and therapeutic segments for new product launches.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams for product development and launch planning.
* Study product positioning, pricing and market potential.

5. Coordination & Reporting

* Work closely with the sales, marketing and management teams.
* Track monthly product-wise sales and brand performance.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly product performance reports.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve sales and brand visibility.

Required Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / B.Sc. / M.Sc. (Life Sciences).
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and product management.

Experience

* 3–6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in pharmaceutical product management or brand management preferred.
* Experience in handling product portfolios, marketing strategies and sales team coordination.

Required Skills

* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Market research and analytical skills.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical products and therapeutic segments.
* Strategic thinking and planning.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Product-wise sales growth.
* New product launch performance.
* Market share and brand growth.
* Promotional strategy effectiveness.
* Sales team product knowledge and training.
* Achievement of product-wise business targets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
